description:
A locally hosted one-stop shop for all your PDF needs

Stirling-PDF is a robust, locally hosted web-based PDF manipulation tool using Docker. It enables you to carry out various operations on PDF files, including splitting, merging, converting, reorganizing, adding images, rotating, compressing, and more. This locally hosted web application has evolved to encompass a comprehensive set of features, addressing all your PDF requirements.
Stirling Office Convert has now replaced Libreoffice in our docker containers!
Along with speed increases and better quality conversions it also means our docker going to half the size! Thank you to everyone who sent us example files, and please keep reporting any conversions that don't look right! We are hoping to get this perfect!
We have also made a big fix for desktop users whose documents were reloading a few seconds after upload, Thank you to everyone who reported this and great to see people using the new feedback button! (In bottom right)
With the Office Convert change (outside of the tools getting the toggle removed)
- Compress now uses Office Convert
- HTML to PDF supports zoom again
- New admin setting to cap how many Office conversions run at once and queue
- Damaged Office, ebook and HTML files now give a clear "could not be read" message instead of an error
Other changes are:
- Faster desktop PDF operations, with the PDF engine now pre-installed in the app
- Performance improvements across the viewer, file list etc
- JPDFium and other dependency updates causing various bug fixes and improvements
We also fixed some bugs including:
- Desktop documents reloading themselves and losing progress shortly after being opened
- Filled form fields showing their value twice in the viewer
- Form values being invisible in dark mode
- Thumbnail sidebar getting stuck on "Loading..." after applying changes
Note (breaking changes):
- PDF to .doc (Word 97-2003) output has been removed. Use docx or odt instead; API calls, pipelines and automations asking for doc will now return an error
- .wpd, .wps, .lwp, .abw, .hwp and .xps files are no longer accepted for conversion
- groupsToRemove entries for removed tools (LibreOffice, Calibre, Weasyprint, OpenCV, etc.) no longer disable anything.
What's Changed
Bug Fixes
- fix(frontend): silence dev proxy ECONNREFUSED spam by @balazs-szucs in #8853
- fix(ui): align add-password advanced dropdown to be more consistent with the rest of the UI by @balazs-szucs in #8760
Enhancements
- Support accessibility tagging of formulas in Text Editor by @EthanHealy01 in #8945
- Send self-hosted Enterprise buyers to the hosted Enterprise page by @reecebrowne in #8940
- Ask signed-out desktop users to sign in for tools that need an account by @Frooodle in #8952
- perf(analytics): start the PostHog client lazily and cut its queue thread wakeups by @balazs-szucs in #8562
- perf(viewer): decouple toolbar notifier subscriptions from state variables by @balazs-szucs in #8438
- perf(files): consolidate filtering and reduce temporary allocations by @balazs-szucs in #8557
- perf(policies): fetch the policy list once per session state by @balazs-szucs in #8357
- refactor(settings): improve accessibility and styling for settings navigation by @balazs-szucs in #8701
- Update and improve zh-TW Traditional Chinese translations by @PeterDaveHello in #8657
- Never reload an open document from disk; only track its original going missing by @Frooodle in #8980
- Fix viewer drawing filled form values twice by @Frooodle in #9007
- Ship JPDFium natives pre-installed in the desktop bundle by @Frooodle in #8843
Other Changes
- build(deps): bump JPDFium to 1.3.1 by @balazs-szucs in #8807
- Replace LibreOffice, Calibre, WeasyPrint and OpenCV with Stirling Office Convert by @Frooodle in #8939
- build(deps): bump JPDFium to 1.3.2 by @Frooodle in #9006
Full Changelog: v3.4.0...v3.5.0
